steps.title: Make 0.001% Triton X-100 bath
steps.instruction: Add 0.05 mL of 100 % Triton X‑100 to Milli‑Q water and dilute to a final volume of 5 L to obtain a 0.001 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 solution; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 7.5% DDM solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.75 g DDM powder, dissolve in 10 mL Milli‑Q water, freeze at –20 °C; this 7.5 % (w/v) DDM stock will be used for lipid solubilisation.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 7.5)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 121.1 g Tris base in ~900 mL Milli‑Q water, adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated HCl, then bring the volume to 1 L; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M Imidazole (pH 7.5)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 68.08 g imidazole in ~900 mL Milli‑Q water, adjust pH to 7.5 with concentrated HCl, then bring the volume to 1 L; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare MelB St dialysis buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 37.5 mL of 4 M NaCl, 20 mL of 1 M Tris‑HCl (pH 7.5), 100 mL of 100 % glycerol, and 1 mL of 10 % DDM (w/v) in a flask; add Milli‑Q water to a final volume of 1 L to give 150 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris‑HCl, 10 % glycerol (v/v) and 0.01 % DDM (w/v). Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare TBS and imidazole buffers
steps.instruction: Make a base TBS (150 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 7.5, bring to 1 L). From this stock prepare three variants: add 5 mM imidazole (5 mL of 1 M imidazole to 1 L), add 25 mM imidazole (20 mL of 1 M imidazole to 1 L), and add 300 mM imidazole (300 mL of 1 M imidazole to 1 L). Store all buffers at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Bio‑Beads for detergent removal
steps.instruction: Pack 20–25 g Bio‑Beads SM‑2 into a 2.5 × 10 cm Bio‑Rad Econo‑Column (≈50 mL volume) with a 250 mL reservoir funnel. Wash sequentially with ~200–250 mL methanol, then ~200–250 mL ethanol, then 10 washes with 2–2.5 L Milli‑Q water. Remove the funnel, transfer the washed beads (still in water) to a 50 mL plastic conical tube and store at 4 °C (stable for 4–6 months).

steps.title: Create lipid mixture at 40 mg/mL
steps.instruction: Weigh 200 mg E. coli polar lipid extract into a pre‑weighed 50 mL conical tube, add 4.5 mL of 7.5 % DDM, vortex 2–3 min, then sonicate in an ice‑cold 0.001 % Triton X‑100 bath: place tube in the bath, sonicate 1 min while pipetting up‑and‑down with a 5 mL serological pipette; cool on ice 5 min. Repeat vortex/sonication cycles 5–7 times (optional 1 min vortex at start of each cycle) avoiding overheating. Measure the suspension volume with the same pipette and adjust to exactly 5 mL with additional 7.5 % DDM to obtain 40 mg/mL lipid concentration.

steps.title: Freeze‑thaw‑sonicate lipid suspension
steps.instruction: Place the 5 mL lipid tube in a glass dewar containing liquid nitrogen, rotate the tube at an angle to form a thin frozen layer on the wall; hold until completely frozen. Thaw at room temperature (≈5–10 min) with gentle shaking, then briefly warm by hand (~5 s). Sonicate the liquid for 30 s, cool on ice 5 min, and repeat the freeze‑thaw‑sonicate cycle 3–4 times until the suspension becomes translucent. Keep the final translucent lipid mixture at room temperature for the next step.

steps.title: Aliquot and store lipid stock
steps.instruction: Dispense 0.5 mL aliquots of the translucent lipid mixture into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C. Frozen aliquots can be thawed at room temperature, sonicated 30 s, and used immediately; they may be refrozen 2–3 times.

steps.title: Mix MelB St with lipids
steps.instruction: In a 20 mL glass vial, add 1 mL His‑tagged MelB St (1 mg/mL, ≈19 µM) and 133 µL of 50 mM lipid stock (6.65 mM total lipids, giving a 1:350 protein‑to‑lipid molar ratio). Mix gently with a pipette (no vortex) and incubate 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add MSP1E3D1∆His and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 365 µL of 260 µM MSP1E3D1∆His to the MelB St/lipid mixture to reach a final MSP concentration of 95 µM (protein‑to‑MSP ratio 1:5). Incubate 30 min at room temperature with intermittent gentle mixing; the mixture should remain clear, indicating no precipitation.

steps.title: Remove detergent with Bio‑Beads
steps.instruction: Weigh the prepared Bio‑Beads (≈800 mg total for 1 mg MelB St). Wash the beads three times with 1 mL TBS by mixing and removing the buffer. Add ~500 mg (≈2/3) of the washed beads to the protein‑lipid mixture, stir gently at 4 °C for 2 h. Add the remaining ~300 mg beads and continue incubation overnight at 4 °C with mild stirring. The suspension should become slightly turbid, indicating nanodisc formation.

steps.title: Clarify nanodisc suspension by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the turbid suspension to a fresh 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, centrifuge 20,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. Carefully collect the supernatant and move it to a clean 2 mL microfuge tube, avoiding any residual Bio‑Beads.

steps.title: Purify nanodiscs by Ni‑affinity chromatography
steps.instruction: Pack 2 mL of 50 % INDIGO Ni‑agarose resin into a gravity column (≈1 mL bed). Wash column with 10 mL Milli‑Q water, then with 10 mL TBS +5 mM imidazole. Add imidazole to the nanodisc suspension to a final concentration of ~5 mM, load onto the column, and wash with 10 mL TBS +5 mM imidazole. Wash twice with 10 mL TBS +25 mM imidazole to remove empty nanodiscs. Elute His‑tagged MelB St nanodiscs with 10 mL TBS +300 mM imidazole, collecting 0.5 mL fractions into 1.5 mL tubes. Pool fractions that show 280 nm absorbance above buffer baseline.

steps.title: Concentrate eluted nanodiscs
steps.instruction: Transfer the pooled eluate to a 2 mL Vivaspin 2 centrifugal concentrator (50 kDa MWCO PES). Centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, mix the concentrate with a transfer pipette, and repeat centrifugation under the same conditions until the volume is reduced to ~0.5 mL, giving an approximate protein concentration of 3 mg/mL.

steps.title: Dialyze nanodiscs into TBS buffer
steps.instruction: Load the concentrated nanodisc solution into a 10 kDa MWCO Slide‑A‑Lyzer dialysis cassette, place the cassette in 1 L TBS buffer (Recipe 4) and dialyze overnight at 4 °C (or room temperature if not specified).
